Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added a Report Bug button (top-right of the header) - sends your AudioHost session log, plugin version, and current status straight to the developer
Moved the Discord invite into Settings > General under a new Community section
